## Dyson V15 Detect Absolute Overview
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
The Dyson V15 Detect Absolute is a powerful cordless vacuum cleaner designed for comprehensive whole-home cleaning. It features advanced technology to detect microscopic dust, measure it, and display the proof on an LCD screen, ensuring a deep and thorough clean.

## Key Features and Specifications

### Core Technologies
-   **Laser Detect Technology**: A precisely angled laser illuminates invisible dust on hard floors, making it visible for thorough cleaning.
-   **Piezo Sensor**: Acoustically senses dust particles, automatically increasing suction power when higher concentrations are detected.
-   **LCD Screen**: Displays the size and number of dust particles, along with real-time performance information like run time and power mode.
-   **Dyson Hyperdymium™ Motor**: Generates powerful suction for deep cleaning carpets and hard floors.
-   **Root Cyclone™ Technology**: 14 cyclones generate forces of up to 100,000g to capture dust and debris without loss of suction.

### Battery Run Time
-   **Up to 60 minutes**: Offers powerful fade-free suction across all floor types in Eco mode. Actual run time varies based on power mode, floor type, and attachments used.

### Main Attachments
-   **Digital Motorbar™ Cleaner Head**: Intelligently adapts suction power to different floor types and de-tangles hair from the brush bar as you clean.
-   **Fluffy Optic™ Cleaner Head**: Engineered with a precisely-angled laser to reveal microscopic dust on hard floors.
-   **Hair Screw Tool**: Anti-tangle conical brush bar picks up long hair and pet hair fast, spiraling it into the bin.
-   **Crevice Tool**: Designed for precise cleaning around edges and narrow gaps.
-   **Combination Tool**: Two tools in one – wide nozzle and brush – for quick switching between cleaning and dusting tasks.
-   **Wand Clip**: Conveniently stores the combination and crevice tools on the wand for easy access.
-   **Docking Station**: Wall-mounted dock to recharge your vacuum and store tools.

## Quick Actions
-   **Learn More at Dyson**: https://www.dyson.com/vacuums/cordless-vacuums/v15/detect-absolute

## Sources
-   **Dyson Official Website**: https://www.dyson.com
